description: This file defines the EmpWorkExperience entity class for the OrangeHRM project. It models an employee's work experience with properties such as employer, job title, dates, comments, and the associated employee, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: EmpWorkExperience
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's work experience with properties mapped to the database, including employer, job title, dates, comments, internal flag, and associated employee.

methods.name: getSeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number identifier for this work experience record.

methods.name: setSeqNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number identifier for this work experience record.

methods.name: getEmployer
methods.description: Returns the employer name for this experience.

methods.name: setEmployer
methods.description: Sets the employer name for this experience.

methods.name: getJobTitle
methods.description: Returns the job title for this experience.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Sets the job title for this experience.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the experience.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the experience.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the experience.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the experience.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns comments associated with this experience.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets comments associated with this experience.

methods.name: getInternal
methods.description: Returns the internal flag for this experience (deprecated).

methods.name: setInternal
methods.description: Sets the internal flag for this experience (deprecated).

methods.description: Returns the Employee entity associated with this experience.

methods.name: setEmployee
